description: This file contains database utility functions for managing MCP server records, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and credential rotation, within a Prisma ORM context. It also handles serialization and encryption of sensitive data.

methods.name: _prepare_mcp_server_data
methods.description: Prepares MCP server data for database insertion, serializing JSON fields and encrypting credentials.

methods.name: encrypt_credentials
methods.description: Encrypts sensitive fields within MCP credentials using a provided encryption key.

methods.name: get_all_mcp_servers
methods.description: Retrieves all MCP server records from the database.

methods.name: get_mcp_server
methods.description: Retrieves a specific MCP server by server ID.

methods.name: get_mcp_servers
methods.description: Retrieves multiple MCP servers by a list of server IDs.

methods.name: get_mcp_servers_by_verificationtoken
methods.description: Retrieves MCP servers associated with a verification token.

methods.name: get_mcp_servers_by_team
methods.description: Retrieves MCP servers associated with a team ID.

methods.name: get_all_mcp_servers_for_user
methods.description: Retrieves MCP servers accessible to a specific user based on verification token and team membership.

methods.name: get_objectpermissions_for_mcp_server
methods.description: Fetches object permission records for a given MCP server.

methods.name: get_virtualkeys_for_mcp_server
methods.description: Fetches virtual keys associated with an MCP server.

methods.name: delete_mcp_server_from_team
methods.description: Placeholder for removing an MCP server from a team.

methods.name: delete_mcp_server_from_virtualkey
methods.description: Placeholder for removing an MCP server from a virtual key.

methods.name: delete_mcp_server
methods.description: Deletes an MCP server record by server ID.

methods.name: create_mcp_server
methods.description: Creates a new MCP server record with data and audit info.

methods.name: update_mcp_server
methods.description: Updates an existing MCP server record with new data.

methods.name: rotate_mcp_server_credentials_master_key
methods.description: Rotates credentials for all MCP servers using a new master key.
